title: Bridging Scales: Energy-Flow Cosmology and the Free Energy Principle as Complementary Entropy Frameworks
description: Presents a formal bridge between Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) and the Free Energy Principle (FEP) by identifying variational free energy with a blanket-integral of a physically measurable energy-flow field. The paper reinterprets Markov blankets as zero-flux energy-flow surfaces, proposes a universal emergence threshold Rc ≈ 0.37, and locks six falsifiable predictions with explicit decision criteria and operational definitions.
author: Morten Magnusson

energy_flow_field.description: Defines the physical energy-flow field coupling entropy gradients to measurable energy flux densities via characteristic power P0, length L0, and a dimensionless flow function φ(S).

blanket_integral_free_energy.description: Defines blanket-integral free energy as the time derivative of total energy flux through the Markov blanket surface M, scaled to information units by kB and effective temperature.

effective_temperature.description: Operational definition of effective temperature via the fluctuation–dissipation relation: variance of internal states over their susceptibility.

resonance_parameter.latex: R = \frac{\lvert E_f^{\mathrm{int}} \rvert}{\lvert E_f^{\mathrm{ext}} \rvert} \cdot \frac{1}{1 + \lvert \nabla S \rvert / S_c}, \quad R_c = 0.37 \pm 0.05
resonance_parameter.description: Resonance parameter controlling blanket stability; stability is predicted when R > Rc with Rc estimated from SPARC galaxy fits and hypothesized to generalize to neural systems.

s_duality.description: S-duality symmetry constraint on the flow function across mid-entropy values, with predicted symmetry breaking near extremes.

efc_fep_correspondence.description: Core correspondence asserting variational free energy equals the blanket-integral free energy up to quasi-steady-state corrections ε.

key_results.main_finding: Variational free energy equals a blanket-integral of the energy-flow field at quasi-steady state, yielding physical Markov blankets and a universal emergence threshold Rc ≈ 0.37 with six locked, falsifiable predictions.
datasets_used: SPARC galaxy rotation curves (for Rc estimate)

sealed_predictions.statement: Dimensional consistency: the EFC mapping yields unit-consistent energy flux and dimensionless free-energy after scaling.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Chi-square ratio for dimensional checks outside [0.95, 1.05] across calibrated benchmark systems.

sealed_predictions.statement: Blanket-integral free energy time series correlates strongly with variational free energy in systems with identifiable Markov blankets.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Pearson correlation Corr(F_blanket, F_variational) ≤ 0.90 over matched time windows with correct blanket identification.

sealed_predictions.statement: Cross-scale universality of the emergence threshold Rc at the onset of stable Markov blankets.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Pooled cross-domain estimate with |z| ≥ 3 against Rc = 0.37 ± 0.05 (e.g., galaxies and neural ensembles).

sealed_predictions.statement: Effective temperature predicts precision (inverse variance) under fluctuation–dissipation scaling.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Explained variance r^2 ≤ 0.30 between T_eff and precision across agents or neural ensembles.

sealed_predictions.statement: Metabolic/energy gradient enrichment at Markov blanket boundaries.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Mean gradient ratio at blankets ≤ 1.2 compared to adjacent non-blanket regions.

sealed_predictions.statement: Symmetry breaking of the S-duality of the flow function at entropy extremes.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Measured deviation of φ(S) from −φ(1−S) ≤ 10% for S < 0.1 or S > 0.9.

kill_criteria: KC1: Failure to observe Corr(F_blanket, F_variational) > 0.90 in controlled systems with independently identified blankets (e.g., active inference agents or neural cultures) using validated E_f measurements and blanket geometry.

KC2: Cross-scale analyses of the resonance parameter R show no clustering around Rc = 0.37 ± 0.05 and yield a pooled |z| ≥ 3 against this value, or stable blankets consistently occur with R outside [0.2, 0.6] across multiple domains.

KC3: No energetic signature of blankets: maxima of |∇E_f| fail to coincide with independently inferred Markov blanket boundaries, and metabolic/energy gradient ratios at blankets do not exceed 1.2 relative to adjacent regions.
KC4: Zero-flux condition is not borne out at candidate blankets: divergence ∇·J at putative blanket surfaces is not significantly lower than in non-blanket control surfaces at NESS.

KC5: Dimensional mapping inconsistency: the scaled blanket-integral definition of F produces system-dependent unit discrepancies (chi-square ratio outside [0.95, 1.05]) that cannot be resolved by parameter calibration within stated definitions.
name: EFC-Bridging-Scales-FEP
abstract: This work presents a formally constrained bridge between the Free Energy Principle and Energy-Flow Cosmology, linking variational free energy to measurable energy flow dynamics across entropy gradients.
